status_rule: VALID when anomalies empty else INVALID

encoding.determinism: byte-identical /app/build/statevec_benchmark_report.json across repeated make run on unchanged fixtures

json_types.norm: quoted JSON string never a JSON number
json_types.reverse_fidelity: quoted JSON string never a JSON number
json_types.re: quoted JSON string never a JSON number
json_types.im: quoted JSON string never a JSON number

encoding.quoted_ten_decimal_strings: norm reverse_fidelity re and im must each be a quoted JSON string with exactly ten digits after the decimal point such as 1.0000000000 or 0.7071067812
encoding.signed_zero: before formatting amplitudes and metrics coerce IEEE negative zero to positive zero so values never print as -0.0000000000

report_structure.amplitudes_order: basis index ascending with little endian qubit zero as least significant bit
report_structure.anomalies_sort: ascending by kind then gate_index then detail

qubit_indexing.rule: qubit zero is the least significant bit of the computational basis index

initial_state: all amplitude mass on basis index zero meaning the all zero ket

gate_semantics.Y: pauli y with imaginary off diagonals
gate_semantics.H: hadamard with entries plus or minus one over square root of two
gate_semantics.S: phase gate diag one and i
gate_semantics.T: t gate diag one and exp i pi over four
gate_semantics.Tdg: diag one and exp negative i pi over four
gate_semantics.RX: single qubit rotation about x using required field theta in radians; matrix [[c,-i s],[-i s,c]] where c=cos(theta/2) and s=sin(theta/2); if theta is absent or null emit UNKNOWN_GATE with detail RX before any qubit range check and do not treat decoy field angle as theta; inverse is RX(-theta); never fuse RX with adjacent gates
gate_semantics.RZ: single qubit rotation about z using required field theta in radians; matrix [[e^{-i theta/2},0],[0,e^{i theta/2}]]; if theta is absent or null emit UNKNOWN_GATE with detail RZ before any qubit range check and do not treat decoy field angle as theta; inverse is RZ(-theta); never fuse RZ with adjacent gates
gate_semantics.CNOT: controlled not with fields control and target; ignore decoy field qubit for addressing
gate_semantics.CZ: controlled z with fields control and target; ignore decoy field qubit for addressing
gate_semantics.CPHASE: two qubit controlled phase with fields control target and phi; multiply amplitude by e^{i phi} when both control and target bits are set; inverse is CPHASE(-phi); ignore decoy field qubit for addressing
gate_semantics.SWAP: swap qubits a and b using fields a and b; if a equals b emit QUBIT_OUT_OF_RANGE with detail swap and stop; ignore decoy field qubit for addressing
gate_semantics.CSWAP: fredkin gate with fields control a and b; when the control bit is one swap qubits a and b otherwise leave the state unchanged; if control equals a or control equals b or a equals b or any of control a b is out of range emit QUBIT_OUT_OF_RANGE with detail cswap and stop; ignore decoy field qubit for addressing; self inverse
gate_semantics.REWIND: control gate with required numeric field depth that unwinds already applied effective steps; missing or null depth emits UNKNOWN_GATE with detail REWIND; negative depth emits UNKNOWN_GATE with detail REWIND; depth zero is a no-op; depth greater than the current execution history length emits REWIND_OVERFLOW with detail overflow and stops; otherwise pop the last depth history entries and apply each entry inverse to the live state; REWIND is never fused and is never itself pushed onto history

control_equals_target: CNOT CZ or CPHASE with control equal to target emits QUBIT_OUT_OF_RANGE with detail cnot cz or cphase respectively and stops
swap_a_equals_b: SWAP with a equal to b emits QUBIT_OUT_OF_RANGE with detail swap and stops
qubit_out_of_range_detail: multi-qubit details are lowercase cnot cz cphase swap cswap; single-qubit details use the gate op spelling unchanged such as X RX or H
rewind_overflow: REWIND with depth greater than the number of effective steps currently in the execution history emits REWIND_OVERFLOW with gate_index equal to the REWIND gate index and detail overflow; it is a structural stop so reverse_fidelity stays 0.0000000000 and NORM_DRIFT and UNITARY_DRIFT are skipped
missing_theta: RX or RZ with theta absent or null emits UNKNOWN_GATE with detail RX or RZ before qubit range checks; decoy angle must never substitute for theta

gate_application.single_qubit: apply two by two matrix on the named qubit without expanding a full dense kronecker product
gate_application.two_qubit: permute or phase amplitudes according to control target bit tests
gate_application.unknown_before_qubit_out_of_range: if op is not in the known gate set emit UNKNOWN_GATE even when the qubit index is out of range

fusion.adjacent_identical_single_qubit: when fuse_adjacent true consecutive identical named single qubit gates drawn only from the set I X Y Z H S T Sdg Tdg on the same qubit collapse to one effective gate using matrix multiply later times earlier
fusion.left_associative_pairwise: fusion walks left to right and collapses one adjacent pair at a time; for three adjacent X gates first XX fuse increments fused_pairs by one then the remaining X is applied so fused_pairs equals one not two
fusion.counted_in_fused_pairs: each collapsed adjacent pair increments fused_pairs by one
fusion.disabled_when: fuse_adjacent false or missing defaults to true
fusion.block_fuse: when the earlier gate of a would-be fused adjacent identical fusable pair has block_fuse true do not fuse; emit FUSION_SKIP with gate_index equal to the earlier gate index and detail equal to the op name; apply both gates separately; continue simulation because FUSION_SKIP is not a structural stop; status is INVALID because anomalies are non-empty; still run NORM_DRIFT and UNITARY_DRIFT post-checks after forward evolution

policy_resolution: defaults then top level circuit fields then policy_overrides via numpolicy.ResolveCircuit; this applies to ghost_eps as well which defaults to zero, may be set by a top level circuit field ghost_eps, and may be overridden by an exact policy_overrides key ghost_eps

ghost_prune.rule: after forward evolution and before phase lock when ghost_eps is greater than zero zero every amplitude whose modulus is strictly below ghost_eps; if at least one previously non-zero amplitude was zeroed renormalize the whole state to unit norm
ghost_prune.norm_metric: the reported norm is computed after ghost prune and before phase lock
ghost_prune.reverse_uses_pre_ghost_state: reverse fidelity is computed from a clone captured before ghost prune so pruning never affects reverse fidelity

phase_lock.rule: after ghost prune and before formatting amplitudes find the smallest basis index i whose amplitude modulus is greater than 1e-15 and multiply the entire state by the conjugate of that amplitude divided by its modulus so that amplitude becomes real and non-negative; if every amplitude modulus is at or below 1e-15 skip phase lock
phase_lock.affects: phase lock changes only the reported amplitudes; the norm is already computed and reverse fidelity uses the pre phase lock clone
phase_lock.signed_zero: still coerce negative zero to positive zero when formatting so amplitudes never print as -0.0000000000

norm_rule: norm is sqrt of sum of amplitude modulus squared formatted to ten decimals
norm_drift: emit NORM_DRIFT with gate_index negative one and detail equal to formatted norm when abs of norm minus one is strictly greater than norm_eps; equality to eps must not emit

execution_history.definition: during forward evolution maintain an ordered history of the effective steps that were successfully applied to the live state
execution_history.fused_pair_is_one_entry: an adjacent fused pair is applied as a single fused matrix and recorded as one history entry
execution_history.fusion_skip_is_two_entries: a FUSION_SKIP applies both gates separately so it records two history entries
execution_history.rewind_not_recorded: REWIND is never pushed onto history; instead it pops and undoes history entries
execution_history.fused_inverse: the inverse of a fused matrix entry is its adjoint which is the conjugate transpose of the two by two matrix

reverse_fidelity.definition: when no structural stop occurred take a clone of the forward state captured before ghost prune and before phase lock, apply the inverse of each execution history entry from the last entry to the first entry, then reverse_fidelity equals the squared modulus of amplitude at basis index zero; never invert the original gates JSON list and never invert entries that a REWIND already popped

inverse_map.fused: adjoint of the fused two by two matrix

reverse_fidelity.unitary_drift: when check_unitary true and abs of reverse_fidelity minus one is strictly greater than fidelity_eps emit UNITARY_DRIFT with gate_index negative one and detail equal to formatted reverse_fidelity; equality to eps must not emit
reverse_fidelity.when_to_run: run reverse fidelity and NORM_DRIFT/UNITARY_DRIFT whenever no structural anomaly stopped forward evolution including when only FUSION_SKIP anomalies are present
reverse_fidelity.on_structural_stop: when UNKNOWN_GATE or QUBIT_OUT_OF_RANGE or REWIND_OVERFLOW stops forward evolution do not run reverse evolution; leave reverse_fidelity at 0.0000000000 and do not emit NORM_DRIFT or UNITARY_DRIFT; never compute fidelity against the partial forward state

invalid_amplitudes: when a structural anomaly fires keep amplitudes as the state reached before the failing gate
gate_index: zero based index into the original gates array before fusion

build_staging.rule: main must call pruneBuildStaging on /app/build before writing the report; after each successful run /app/build holds only qwavectl and statevec_benchmark_report.json

main_paths.corpusDir: must be the string literal /app/wavefn_corpus assigned with corpusDir := "/app/wavefn_corpus"
